stem: Name the red structures on these feet. The red structures are the ___.
explanation: The red bones are the phalanges, the toe bones. Each toe has three (proximal, middle, distal) except the big toe, which has two.

stem: Identify the structure in green. The green structure is the ___.
explanation: The green bone is the navicular, a tarsal bone on the medial side of the foot between the talus and the cuneiforms.

stem: Name the following structure. #7 on this skull is the ___ bone.
explanation: #7 is the zygomatic bone, the cheekbone. Its temporal process joins the temporal bone to form the zygomatic arch.

stem: Name the following structure. Number 18 on the skull is the ___.
explanation: Number 18 is the mandible, the lower jaw. It is the only movable bone of the skull.

stem: Name the following structures. The bones highlighted in red are the ___.
explanation: The red bones are the tibias (shinbones), the larger, weight-bearing bones of the lower leg on the medial side. The thinner fibula is lateral.

stem: Name the red structures at the knees. The red structures are the ___.
explanation: The red bones are the patellae (kneecaps), sesamoid bones inside the tendon of the quadriceps that protect the knee joint.

stem: The structure highlighted in red is the ___.
correct: mastoid|mastoid process|mastoid process of the temporal bone
explanation: The red structure is the mastoid process of the temporal bone, just behind the ear. Neck muscles such as the sternocleidomastoid attach to it.

stem: What type of tissue is this? Be specific. This is a slide of a(n) ___.
explanation: This is an osteon (Haversian system), the structural unit of compact bone: rings of lamellae around a central canal, with osteocytes in lacunae.

stem: Name the brown structure. The brown structure is the ___.
correct: hair root|root of the hair|hair shaft|hair|hair follicle
explanation: The brown structure below the skin's surface is the hair root, sitting inside the hair follicle. The part above the surface is the hair shaft.

stem: Name the phase this cell is in. This cell is in the mitosis phase: ___.
explanation: The chromosomes are lined up in a single row across the middle of the cell, so the cell is in metaphase.

stem: Name this structure. This structure is the ___.
correct: meissner's corpuscle|meissners corpuscle|meissner corpuscle|meissner's corpuscles|tactile corpuscle|meissner's|meissners
explanation: This is a Meissner's (tactile) corpuscle, a touch receptor in the dermal papillae just under the epidermis that senses light touch.

stem: Name the bone. The arrow is pointing to the ___ bone.
explanation: The arrow points to the scaphoid, a carpal (wrist) bone on the thumb side. It is the most commonly fractured carpal bone.

stem: Name the bone on this skeleton model. The arrow is pointing to the ___.
explanation: The arrow points to the clavicle (collarbone), which connects the sternum to the scapula and is part of the pectoral girdle.

stem: Name the bone in this foot. The arrow is pointing to the ___.
explanation: The arrow points to the calcaneus, the heel bone and the largest tarsal bone. The Achilles tendon attaches to it.

stem: Name the structure. The dark area identified above is the ___.
correct: central canal|haversian canal|central (haversian) canal|central canal (haversian canal)
explanation: The dark hole in the center of the osteon is the central (Haversian) canal, which carries blood vessels and nerves through compact bone.

stem: Name the phase. The arrow is pointing to a cell in ___.
explanation: The arrow points to a cell with two separate clusters of chromosomes at opposite ends and a new cell wall forming between them: telophase.

stem: Name the layer. The arrow is pointing to the ___.
explanation: The arrow points to the stratum spinosum, the thick layer of the epidermis above the stratum basale where cells are joined by desmosomes.

stem: Name the structure. The structure shown is the ___.
explanation: This is a sebaceous (oil) gland beside the hair follicle. It secretes sebum into the follicle to soften hair and skin.

stem: Name the structure. The arrow is pointing to the ___.
correct: sudoriferous gland|sudoriferous glands|sudoriferous|sweat gland|sweat glands|eccrine gland|eccrine sweat gland
explanation: The coiled tubes deep in the dermis are a sudoriferous (sweat) gland, which secretes sweat to cool the body.

stem: Name the phase. The phase identified here is ___.
explanation: The arrow points to a cell with an intact nucleus and no visible chromosomes. The cell is in interphase, not yet dividing.
